gate0_pit.notes: C11 detector flags verified as false positives — v7.1 macro_regime.parquet has apply_month lag built in. NCO uses 120d rolling data. DD brake t-1 lagged.

gate1_implementability.notes: 5 sleeves x 6. HRP/NCO weights capped at 15%.

gate2_robustness.notes: MDD 24.76% < 25% target. OOS retention 88.6% excellent. 91% of 3Y rolling windows positive. 4/4 stress outperform.

gate4_statistical.notes: FF3 alpha 9.10% (t=2.55, p=0.012). FF5 alpha 11.32% (t=2.89, p=0.005). Below Harvey t>3.0 but strong.

commentary.strength: Strongest Sharpe (1.358) among recent batch. OOS retention 88.6% — minimal overfitting. FF5 alpha significant at 1%. All 3 target metrics met (CAGR 17.81%, SR 1.358, MDD 24.76%).
commentary.weakness: MDD 24.76% very close to 25% limit. Harvey t>3.0 not met. Code uses old MRS pattern (recommend regime_engine_daily.R migration).
commentary.verdict_reason: Grade A: All targets met, strong OOS retention, significant FF alpha. NCO weighting innovation over HRP delivers measurable improvement over STR_1036.
commentary.improvement: Migrate MRS code to regime_engine_daily.R for explicit PIT compliance. Tighten DD brake to push MDD below 24%.
commentary.comparison: vs STR_1036 (SR 1.284): +0.074 SR improvement from NCO. vs STR_1071 (CAGR 21.49%): lower CAGR but better OOS retention. Production upgrade candidate over STR_1034 (SR 1.155).
